summary: With u = x_T and [u] = genIndex(u): md(u)⁻¹ = (√[u])² = [u] (inv_md_eq_sqrt_genIndex_sq), and √[u] = ∏_v |Φ_v(x)| (both inequalities of sqrt_genIndex_le_prod_norm, applied to x and to x⁻¹); hence md(u)^{1/2} = (∏_v |Φ_v(x)|)⁻¹.

steps.claim: md(u)⁻¹ = √[u]², and √[u] = ∏_v|Φ_v(x)| by the two inequalities for x and x⁻¹;
steps.lean:
erw [inv_eq_iff_eq_inv.1 (P.inv_md_eq_sqrt_genIndex_sq u),
    (sqrt_genIndex_le_prod_norm T ⟨x.ne_zero, h.1⟩).antisymm (by
    simpa [u, genIndex_eq_inv_prod_norm] using
      inv_anti₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (genIndex_pos u⁻¹)) (sqrt_genIndex_le_prod_norm T ⟨by simp, h.2⟩))]
